thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, both arms: a dark bedroom, bedside lamp just switched off, a person settling under a quilt, face relaxed. Surbahar at the FRAME EDGE, NOT being played. Deep indigo with a single warm amber pool of light. Pichwai/Kangra border, aged parchment, house palette. Text banner ~35% of frame, second tier 'Surbahar · Raga Bageshri'. VIEWER, never a performer.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — gentle Indian classical surbahar in Raga Bageshri, deep resonant plucked tone with long natural decay and warm sustain, continuous tanpura drone underneath, no tabla, 56 BPM, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: ⚠️ SPECCED AGAINST h_2026-09-05_3hr_tempo_retention_floor. 56 BPM — ABOVE the ~55 floor, deliberately NOT the 48 BPM that put Snowy Night (2026-09-04) at 7.2% AVD, below the 9.5% worst first-AVD ever recorded on a 3hr ship. Bageshri is a late-night raga but NOT all-komal, unlike Malkauns/Darbari. 'gentle', never 'very slow'. Register is RELAXATION, not deep-sleep-drag — our 46,338-engaged 3hr winner was 'Bansuri Music for Relaxation'. Binaural: delta 3 Hz at -20dB.

production_spec.loop_note: 6-7 gentle Bageshri surbahar clips over a continuous tanpura bed, long crossfades to ~3hr, consistent low night level. No percussion anywhere.
